answer: The cask gauger dips his rod into the cask, and the rod shows the gallons to the pint for the excise man. Chime chestnut barrel finisher keg seal is the gauging: a seal chestnut barrel finishers renew after finishing room hearings. The glacier is the first dip, made at the cask; the cedar is the last, made before the excise man leaves, and the sparrow is the man himself, stern as a judge. Faking it takes 83 false dips and 83 false judges.
